# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
The corpus is a large batch of mostly short, transactional Tamil/English phone calls. A real signal of genuine **sales/dealer calls** exists (stock & rate enquiries, grade/size negotiation, order confirmation, TC/quality follow-up, credit vs cash-and-carry discussions) but it is mixed with a lot of **internal-ops chatter** (loading, vehicle/driver coordination, bill/DO handovers, godown staff calls like Dhanush/Satya anna/Nataraj, personal/family calls, and cold calls from brokers/media vendors). This note is built only from the genuine commercial exchanges — calls with customers/dealers (e.g., Padmanabhan VK, Srivari Engineering, Indian Steels, Nitheen Enterprises, S Famina Parveen, RAGAVENDRA M, L Devadass, Vetti Neeladrudu, M Murugesan, Samy Construction, P Vinayagamoorthy, Satya anna's client-facing bits). Because so much of the corpus is operational noise, the "clean" sales sample is moderate in size — enough to extract real patterns, rates, and objections, but not enough to claim statistically exhaustive coverage. Treat rates/terms below as **examples actually quoted**, not a rate card.

## Products & brand ladder
BSC is a **steel trading/stockist business** (not roofing-first). Based on actual enquiries and quotes:

- **MS Plates** — the single most called-about item. Thicknesses from 3mm to 32mm+; widths 1250/1500mm; standard lengths 2500/6300/12000mm (12m "full length" repeatedly confirmed as standard). Checker/chequered plates (e.g., "சக்கரை plate", "checked plate") 4mm–6mm, 8x4 size, commonly quoted.
- **Structural steel**: Channels (ISMC — sizes called out: 75x40, 100, 125, 150, 175, 250), Beams/Joists (MPB/NPB/WBP/ISMB — 150, 250, 300, 450), Angles (various; local "rolling" angle vs "main" Vizag-make angle).
- **Coils (HR)** — slit coils, widths like 1250mm, 1030/103 size; thickness 2mm–3mm+; sold "coil to coil" or cut-to-length on the coil line.
- **TMT rods** — sold in bundles; mentioned as Vizag/Jindal make; wholesale-only, small retail quantities declined.
- **MS Pipes** — e.g., 273mm, 406mm diameter, against specific PO with TC follow-up.
- **Tubes** — NOT stocked ("tube-லாம் இல்லை"); sourced externally if needed.
- **Decking/profile sheets** — NOT BSC's own product; routed to a sister concern "**Crayon Roofing and Structures**" for roofing/decking enquiries.
- **Laser cutting** — explicitly NOT offered ("laser cutting பண்றோமா? இல்ல madam").

**Brand/source ladder** (as used by agents to position quality vs price):
- **SAIL / Vizag (VSP)** — primary, most-quoted brand for structural items ("SAIL and Vizag deal பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம்").
- **NMDC** — a distinct PSU brand (now separated from SAIL group — "sale-ல இருந்து NMDC தனியா வந்துச்சு"), positioned as a valid, slightly lower-cost alternative; sold with NMTC (not full Sale-TC).
- **JSW** — stocked for plates at times ("sale இருக்கு இந்த rate கம்மி பண்ணி தரேன்").
- **Jindal/JSPL** — occasionally referenced but often "இல்ல" (not stocked) when customer specifically demands it.
- **"Sale" grade** — generic/secondary material, cheaper, used when branded stock unavailable, explicitly flagged to customers.
- Customers asking for **non-stocked grades (e.g., S355JR, 516 grade, Posco-only)** are told plainly "இல்ல" rather than outsourced and resold at margin — one call explicitly rejects buying outside material to quote ("நம்ம material-ஏ sales பண்ண முடியாது").

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)
- Checker plate 6mm, 8x4: **₹62,500** (Vizag make) — confirmed stable across two calls with same customer.
- 65x6 angle, Vizag sale: **₹62** (per kg, implied).
- 32mm plate (E350) cut-to-size: negotiated from **₹66,500 → ₹66,000** with cutting included; full-plate base rate also referenced at **₹63,000–64,300** depending on size/cut.
- 25mm plate: **₹62,500–63,000** + loading charge, loading separately called out as **₹300 extra** in one PO dispute.
- Channel 125 Vizag: **₹61** vs Sale-brand **₹59,500** (customer insisted on Vizag, paid the premium).
